result.title: ZeroMAG: Zero-Shot Multimodal Adapter Generation for Plug-and-Play EEG Foundation Models
result.summary: EEG foundation models (EFMs) capture reusable knowledge from large-scale EEG data, while many EEG recordings also include companion physiological signals that provide complementary information beyond the EEG-only interface. The challenge is to preserve this pretrained knowledge while extending the EFM to heterogeneous multimodal recordings through an adaptation inferred from unlabeled target data. We introduce ZeroMAG, a zero-shot multimodal adapter generation framework that extends a frozen EEG encoder and prediction head using unlabeled target recordings, without target labels or target-side optimization. The target datasets are held out from all model training and selection in the ZeroMAG pipeline. ZeroMAG organizes companion modalities around a configuration-invariant adapter, constructs a modality-subject-task condition from unlabeled recordings and task context, and generates adapter weights in a function-constrained latent space learned from source adapters. Across six held-out target datasets and three EFM backbones, ZeroMAG improves balanced accuracy by 7.22 percentage points over EEG-only inference and 4.89 points over direct weight regression, while coming within 0.50 points of supervised multimodal adaptation on average. Ablations further show that removing functional supervision from either representation learning or conditional generation degrades generated-adapter performance, confirming the contribution of both components.

AI.brief_summary: ZeroMAG 提出零样本多模态适配器生成框架：冻结 EEG 基础模型编码器，利用无标签目标记录与任务上下文构造条件，在受函数约束的 latent 空间中生成适配器权重，从而扩展到含伴随生理信号的多模态记录。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「条件化生成 latent 适配状态、并以函数约束监督该表示」的思路，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态的生成与训练监督问题相通，可供核查是否能迁移到 VLM 推理状态的动态生成与贡献分配。
